item.title: Furious Trump Imposes 1000% Tariff On Supreme Court
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — Following a ruling stripping him of his ability to impose emergency tariffs, a visibly furious President Donald Trump imposed a 1,000% tariff on the United States Supreme Court.

item.title: Gavin Newsom's Presidential Ambitions Sunk After Nation Discovers He's The One Running California
item.description: SACRAMENTO, CA — Governor Gavin Newsom's presidential prospects tanked sharply this week after the nation finally realized he was the guy running California.

item.title: Tucker Uncovers Shocking Evidence That Israel Controlled By Jews
item.description: TEL AVIV — Shortly after landing at Ben Gurion Airport to conduct an interview with U.S. Ambassador Mike Huckabee, commentator Tucker Carlson reportedly uncovered shocking evidence that Israel is controlled by the Jews.

item.title: California Truck Driver Cited For Being Legal U.S. Resident
item.description: SAN DIEGO, CA — During a routine traffic stop, a California truck driver with a valid Class A driver's license was reportedly pulled over by law enforcement and cited after officers discovered he was a legal U.S. resident.

item.title: American Women’s Bobsled Team Comes In Last After Stopping To Ask For Directions
item.description: CORTINA D'AMPEZZO — The gold medal hopes of one pair of U.S. athletes were dashed this week, as the American women's bobsled team came in last place after stopping to ask for directions.

item.title: Top 10 Most Brilliant Disguises Of James O'Keefe
item.description: Investigative journalist James O'Keefe, famous for going undercover to source his groundbreaking stories, has built a legendary reputation as an unparalleled master of disguise.
